name: Jayson Burrows
caption: The owner and president of Wrestling Unplugged, who vanished from his office in December 2008; as Jason Burrows, 'the former owner of Wrestling Unplugged' who returned to 96 in October 2009 to demand an executive post, fought the owner for the company and signed Osh Vaughan.

tenures.source: Its staff page (28 December 2008): 'WU Owner'; its shows have him behind the desk until the Parental Advisory of 8 December, and its news recap says he disappeared from his office that night.
Its eXposes of 26 October ('The Former Owner of Wrestling Unplugged Jason Burrows' demands an executive post), 3 November (claims to own 96) and 9 November 2009 (signs Osh Vaughan).

name: Chris Icon
caption: Listed as Commissioner, whose staff biography reads only 'Please Come Again'.

tenures.source: Its staff page (28 December 2008): 'WU Commissioner'; the first Parental Advisory's intro shows him laid out in the ring.

name: Jinx
caption: The Devil's Jester, a painted-face clown who debuted at Wrestling Unplugged's first Parental Advisory on 22 September 2008, a friend and then foil of Requiem and a rival of DLS; he held the Elite title of the company that returned as Wrestling Unplugged in 2009 until Requiem beat him for it on 7 June, and was hurt in the Chaotic Cage of 18 October 2009.

tenures.source: Its roster page and its Parental Advisory cards from 22 September 2008; the announced card of 29 December.

Its eXposes of 27 April and 6 May 2009 (Elite title contender), Screaming For Vengeance ('the current Elite Champion, JINX') and Parental Advisory 11. After the relaunch of 18 October 2009: its Revolution pay-per-view (fifth into the cage; hurt in the match), its eXposes of 26 October (lost to Melody), 3 November (lost by disqualification to Colton Vargas after Rico Sutton wrote 'DLS' on his forehead) and 9 November 2009 (beat Rico Sutton).

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Twilight Rayn
caption: One Shot champion from The Bleeding on 19 October 2008 until Troy Gafgen took the belt on 17 November, a vampire-gimmick rival of Hallow Wicked; in June 2009 he laid out Skit-Zo and Hallow Wicked and lost a Commonwealth title match to Makayla Fox.

tenures.source: Its One Shot page (champion from The Bleeding on 19 October 2008), its roster and its Parental Advisory cards.

Its Screaming For Vengeance (a vignette in which he lays out Skit-Zo and Hallow Wicked) and Parental Advisory 11 (lost to Makayla Fox for the Commonwealth title); its pay-per-view clips show him pouring lighter fluid on a casket.

name: Troy Gafgen
caption: One Shot champion from 17 November to 8 December 2008; a 'former WU star' at ringside at Screaming For Vengeance in June 2009 beside Skull Daze.

tenures.source: Its One Shot page (champion from 17 November 2008) and its Parental Advisory cards.
Its Screaming For Vengeance: 'two former WU stars, Skull Daze and Troy Gafgen' at ringside.

name: CJ Gates
caption: Signed in November 2008 and won the One Shot title on 8 December.

tenures.source: Its One Shot page (champion from 8 December 2008); the sixth Parental Advisory's Burrows announces the signing.

name: Chad Vargas
caption: The Confederate Icon, with his guitar and 'King Cobra' shirt: first Contender champion at See No Evil on 14 September 2008, then, in the 96 pages, Lugar champion from 6 May 2009 until Drake Daniels beat him for it at Screaming For Vengeance.

tenures.source: Its One Shot page (first Contender Champion at See No Evil on 14 September 2008) and its Parental Advisory cards.

Its eXposes of 27 April and 6 May 2009 ('THE NEW LUGAR CHAMPION…CHAD VARGAS'), the 17 May main event, Screaming For Vengeance ('the Confederate Icon and Current Lugar Champion') and Parental Advisory 11.

name: Skull Daze
caption: One Shot champion in October 2008, who cashed the belt in at once; a 'former WU star' at ringside at Screaming For Vengeance in June 2009 beside Troy Gafgen.

tenures.source: Its One Shot page (champion from 13 October 2008, after cashing in), its Parental Advisory cards and the eighth Parental Advisory's backstage scenes (8 December 2008).
Its Screaming For Vengeance: 'two former WU stars, Skull Daze and Troy Gafgen' announce at ringside that they are in love and getting married.

name: David Gunn
caption: The first Short Circuit champion, who lost the belt to Porter MaCleod at The Bleeding.

tenures.source: Its Short Circuit page: the first Short Circuit champion, from See No Evil on 14 September 2008, until The Bleeding on 19 October 2008; Thankful Sins (23 November 2008), a One Shot title match.

name: Luther Savage
caption: A roster member billed the number one contender for the One Shot title on the 29 December 2008 card.

tenures.source: The eighth Parental Advisory (8 December 2008) introduces his signing; he debuts on the ninth ('Also making his debut here at Wrestling Unplugged'), wins the One Shot contendership on the tenth and is billed on the 29 December card.

name: Joey Bohnny
caption: An Elvis-impersonator wrestler billed on its cards.

tenures.source: Thankful Sins (23 November 2008: 'This is the King's first time here in Japan'), the eighth to tenth Parental Advisory cards and the 29 December card.

name: Brandon Maddox
caption: The self-styled richest man in Wrestling Unplugged, a manager and then rival of Doom and of Requiem in autumn 2008; he debuted at 96 on 6 May 2009 promising to be 'the new front man of this company', challenged Makayla Fox for the Commonwealth title in June, and lost to Carmine Vestieri on 9 November 2009.

tenures.source: Its roster page (captured 28 December 2008) and its cards; The Bleeding, the Parental Advisory of 17 November and Thankful Sins.

Its eXposes of 6 May (his debut promo: 'I have joined the 96 Promotions') and 17 May 2009, Screaming For Vengeance (the Commonwealth challenger) and Parental Advisory 11. After the relaunch of 18 October 2009: its eXposes of 26 October (absent on a delayed flight), 3 November (an elimination tag draw with Melody) and 9 November 2009 (lost to Carmine Vestieri).

name: Barbie Bank
caption: Listed on its December 2008 roster page.

tenures.source: Its roster page.

name: Timmy Gump
caption: Listed on its December 2008 roster page.

tenures.source: Its roster page.

name: Mason Dixon
caption: Billed to debut on the 29 December 2008 card after an attack on Joey Bohnny.

tenures.source: The ninth Parental Advisory (15 December 2008), as Chad Vargas's bodyguard and manager, the tenth, its roster page and the 29 December card, billed to make his in-ring debut.

name: T Tumble
caption: Billed on the first and third Parental Advisory cards.

tenures.source: Its first and third Parental Advisory cards.

name: Laura Seton
caption: Billed in a three-way for the Contender title on the first card and again in the eighth Parental Advisory's three-way.

tenures.source: Its first Parental Advisory card and its One Shot page.

name: Mrs. Ruiz
caption: Billed against Requiem in a falls count anywhere match on the first card.

tenures.source: Its first Parental Advisory card (falls count anywhere with Requiem).

name: Dean Wolf
caption: Billed on the first card and in the 'loser leaves or kisses Evans ass' match on the second.

tenures.source: Its first and second Parental Advisory cards; billed against Eric Evans in a loser-leaves match.

name: Eric Draven
caption: Billed the Angel of Vengeance and a rival of Hallow Wicked.

tenures.source: Its first and second Parental Advisory cards, its blurb 'Draven's Angel' and the fourth card (the Coterie of the Shade).

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Deacon Wolfe
caption: Billed on the first three Parental Advisory cards.

tenures.source: Its first, second and third cards.

name: DLS
caption: A World title contender at See No Evil in September 2008 and Jinx's rival through that autumn; 'the former Wrestling Unplugged superstar DLS' joined 96 on 9 November 2009.

tenures.source: Its World Championship History (beaten at See No Evil), its cards and Thankful Sins (23 November 2008), the Hospital Room Brawl.
Its eXposes of 3 November (the initials Rico Sutton writes on Jinx's forehead) and 9 November 2009 ('the former Wrestling Unplugged superstar DLS').

name: Marquise
caption: Billed in a four-way on the second card and fired on the third.

tenures.source: Its second and third cards.

name: Brian Cruise
caption: Billed on the second card and a no-show on the third.

tenures.source: Its second and third cards.

name: Cameron Drake
caption: Billed on the first and second Parental Advisory cards, then put on notice.

tenures.source: Its first and second cards, The Feed, Vol. V, and the sixth and eighth Parental Advisory cards.

name: Chris Legend
caption: Billed on the second card and for the Short Circuit title on the third.

tenures.source: Its second and third cards.

name: Doom
caption: A masked rival of Requiem, in the Doom Alliance with Chad Vargas.

tenures.source: Its second, third and fourth cards.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.
The 96 pages bill 'October Doom'; the older company's Doom wore a mask and a green cloak, and nothing on the 96 pages ties the two, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Meagan Tallet
caption: Billed against Porter MaCleod on the third card and released in November 2008.

tenures.source: Its third card (the MaCleod Invitational) and The Feed, Vol. V.

name: Nigel Riechert
caption: Billed for the One Shot title on the fourth card.

tenures.source: The Bleeding (19 October 2008: 'Nigel making his debut here'), the fourth and sixth cards and its Rankings page.

name: Reuben MaCleod
caption: Porter MaCleod's relation in Clan MacLeod.

tenures.source: The Bleeding (19 October 2008, the special enforcer), the fourth card, the seventh card's Clan MacLeod and Thankful Sins (23 November 2008).

name: Chris Caliber
caption: The Canadian Charisma, who won a three-way on the eighth Parental Advisory and debuted with Jay Copeland as The Elite on the ninth.

tenures.source: Its eighth Parental Advisory (8 December 2008: he wins a three-way, 'Not a bad way to start off your stint with WU'), the ninth (with Jay Copeland as The Elite) and the 29 December card.

name: Jay Copeland
caption: Debuted with Chris Caliber as The Elite on the ninth Parental Advisory and was billed against Drake Daniels on the 29 December 2008 card.

tenures.source: Its ninth Parental Advisory (15 December 2008: 'Making there debut here at Wrestling Unplugged…THE ELITE!', with Chris Caliber) and the 29 December 2008 card.

name: Stalker Knight
caption: Put on watch in November 2008 and billed on the sixth and seventh cards.

tenures.source: The fourth Parental Advisory (26 October 2008: 'I think his name is Stalker Knight from GCW'), The Feed, Vol. V, and the sixth and seventh cards.

name: Red Dragon
caption: Put on watch in November 2008 and billed on the seventh and eighth cards.

tenures.source: The fourth Parental Advisory (26 October 2008: 'many know me by Red Dragon'), The Feed, Vol. V, and the seventh to ninth cards.
